title: New York hospital financial aid (Public Health Law 2807-k(9-a))

rules.title: Free care under 200% FPL
rules.plain: Under 200% of the poverty line, New York hospitals must waive all charges.
rules.quote: the hospital shall waive all charges

rules.title: Sliding scale to 400% FPL, capped against Medicaid rates
rules.plain: Between 200% and 400% of the poverty line, you pay on a sliding scale capped at 10% to 20% of what Medicaid would pay.
rules.quote: up to a maximum of ten percent of the amount that would have been paid

rules.title: Payment plans and lawsuit limits
rules.plain: Payment plans are capped at 5% of your gross monthly income, with at most 2% interest. Hospitals can't sue patients under 400% of the poverty line, and must wait 180 days after the first bill before any lawsuit.
rules.quote: shall not exceed five percent of the gross monthly income of the patient
rules.notes: Hospitals must also give at least 30 days' notice before sending a debt to collections (9-a(h)).
